audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer field addressed Orianna as 'he/his/him', and the difficulty text never gave the range gap that defines the lane.
audit.why: Orianna is female (champ-gender.js). Command: Attack is 815 range on 7/6/5/4/3s and the ball stays where it lands, so her effective poke range is ball position plus 815 against your 750-range beam.
audit.corrected: Difficulty is a range-and-ball problem: you are outranged while the ball sits forward, and every commit has to be measured from the ball, not from Orianna.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named Aurelion Sol's ultimate 'Voice of Light' and his Q 'Q Starfire', and gave no real cooldown for the level 6 threat.
audit.why: His are Breath of Light (Q, 750) and Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R, 120/110/100s, 1250). Command: Shockwave is 110/95/80s and reaches 410 units around the ball.
audit.corrected: Spikes restated with real names and numbers: her 6 is a 110s shockwave centred on the ball; yours is Rod of Ages, and the endgame is The Skies Descend against a champion with no dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called Command: Dissonance a 'shield-slow' and never stated that Command: Shockwave's displacement cancels Aurelion Sol's channels.
audit.why: Riot's Command: Dissonance text is a pulse leaving a field that speeds allies and slows enemies — there is no shield on it. The shield is Command: Protect (E, 9s, 1095 range), which also grants armour and magic resist to the ally it attaches to. Command: Shockwave launches enemies toward the ball, and both Breath of Light and Astral Flight are flagged interruptible channels.
audit.corrected: State the decisive one: the shockwave launch cancels your beam and your flight, so the ball's position is what decides whether you may channel at all. Command: Protect can shield the target you are burning, and it is her only shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags a contradiction: Aurelion Sol wins 59.68% of 506 games but the chart hands Orianna 6 of 7 stages.
audit.why: The stage-by-stage reads correctly for a scaling champion who is outranged for the whole laning phase, and the 2+ items row is his. The kit does not tell me which of the middle rows is actually wrong.
audit.corrected: Left the sides as the content layer already had them and fixed only the rows where the two layers disagreed. Recorded here rather than guessed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-layer chart disagreement on three rows: phases[4..6].side all read 'Skill' while win[4], win[5], win[6] read 'Orianna', 'Orianna', 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: The same row rendered two different answers to who wins that stage.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and phases[5].side -> Orianna, phases[6].side -> Aurelion Sol, with the whys rewritten in the same proposal so no row argues with itself.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed — 'Farm the back line with E executes' was explained by a W flyby, and 'Fly W into his cooldown-loaded face' by a Q channel.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

notes: Orianna is female — every full-layer field used he/his/him; corrected. Fabricated names removed: 'Q Starfire' and 'Voice of Light' are not Aurelion Sol abilities. Command: Dissonance was described as a 'shield-slow' in two places; Riot's text is a pulse leaving a field that speeds allies and slows enemies, with no shield — her only shield is Command: Protect (E, 9s, 1095 range, also grants armour and magic resist). The decisive interaction was never stated: Command: Shockwave launches enemies toward the ball, and that displacement cancels both Breath of Light and Astral Flight, which is why the ball's position and not Orianna's decides whether you may channel. Cross-layer chart disagreement fixed on rows 5, 6 and 7. UNRESOLVED and not guessed: the packet defect that a 59.68% win rate sits under a chart giving Orianna 6 of 7 stages — the kit does not tell me which middle row is wrong, so the sides were left as the content layer had them.
